label: Classic 3D story — M35 hero (WebGL)
description: Same page as Classic 3D, with a new hero animation: all four original drawings told as one 28 s loop in black and white (negative), with the chapters of the Glass 3D hero. The data frame of drawing 2 draws itself seen from above, the frame turns and the rays go back into the ring, a fast tilt to 3D; the board's dashed drips run and each tier is built like drawing 3 (rim, dashed drips down its wall, the wall coming down from the rim); close-up on the top for drawing 4 (the star draws, the frosting falls onto it); pull back to drawing 1 (beads pop in, beads slide down the drips, the star spins); then everything undraws in sequence and tilts back to the flat view. White modules as in Classic 3D. Tuner: press T.
